customer_drafts.subject: Update on your Bulldog tee
customer_drafts.body:
Hi Tauhid,

We’re currently out of the white Bulldog tee in size S, so we can’t fill your order today. Our supplier’s restock is on hold while a payment is awaiting approval and processing. If that hold is cleared and the shipment proceeds, September 5 is the earliest it could arrive, but we can’t promise that date yet.

We’ll share an update when we have a confirmed restock timeline.

Best,
Campus Customs

tickets.short_outcome: Do not commit a discount or restock yet: the requester did not specify a discount rate or whether they prefer a partial fill or to wait for all 20. Eight size M hoodies are available now; the remaining 12 would require a restock.
tickets.summary: Inventory confirmed 8 of 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY size M are on hand, a shortfall of 12. Bulldog Print Co can ship with a 5-day lead time, making September 5, 2026 the earliest possible restock date; the vendor has no open unpaid invoice. Accounting reported $58 current price and $22 unit cost, so any price below $22 would be below cost; no specific discount was provided, and the $264 restock cost was only an estimate, not a confirmed purchase-order amount. No restock or payment was prepared. Ticket payment lookup shows no payment requests for this ticket. A customer reply draft asks for the requested discount and fulfillment preference, without promising delivery.

agents.contribution: Read ticket 103, sent Inventory then Accounting then Customer Service; prepared no payment and set the ticket needs_human with three open questions (discount rate, partial fill, PO amount).

Found 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY in size M against 20 (short 12); Bulldog Print Co can ship now (invoice 501 was paid on ticket 101), 5-day lead, Sept 5 the earliest. Asked again by Accounting, it re-confirmed the same facts and the $264 restock cost. Its first list_vendors call had made-up arguments and was rejected; the retry was correct.

Asked Inventory to confirm stock and cost, then ran check_margin three times: $22 unit cost is break-even, $36/unit ($720) margin at the $58 list price, $30.20/unit ($604) at an example 10% discount. Called the $264 restock an estimate and prepared no purchase order. Did not check cash.

Drafted a reply to Yale AI Club: 8 available now at $58, 12 need a restock (Sept 5 earliest, not promised), and asked what discount they want and whether they prefer 8 now + 12 later or all 20 at once. Not sent.
